goal: Improve the reliability and planning of the PARALLAX skill engine through independently checked, low-risk changes.

tasks.title: Inspect source tree and run baseline tests
acceptance: Record source revision and baseline test results in a timestamped log

tasks.title: Specify task DAG and protected invariants
acceptance: Validate all dependencies and acceptance criteria before running tasks

tasks.title: Implement permission-bounded planning engine
acceptance: Reject cycles, unknown dependencies, nonfinite durations and unauthorized deliveries

tasks.title: Create negative regression tests and fixtures
acceptance: Run edge-case tests that detect invalid schedules and false evidence

tasks.title: Run four independent specialist code audits
acceptance: Review four separately attributed auditor results and resolve blocking findings

tasks.title: Publish approved changes to the correct GitHub repo
acceptance: Verify commit SHA, repository visibility and green GitHub Actions before claiming release
